PR-Deflection-Service-Token

Plan: web/plans/PR-Deflection-Service-Token.md
Slice phase: Production hardening

Moves the support-ticket-deflection funnel from a JWT-only ATLAS credential to a durable service-token contract: the portfolio server now prefers ATLAS_B2B_SERVICE_TOKEN and falls back to ATLAS_B2B_JWT during rollout.

Intentional:
- ATLAS_B2B_JWT remains a temporary fallback while the service-token env rolls out.
- The service token stays server-only; no NEXT_PUBLIC_ env is introduced.
- This slice changes consumption, not API-key minting or Vercel env provisioning.

Deferred:
- Mint atlas-portfolio-deflection-prod with content_ops:deflection:*, set ATLAS_B2B_SERVICE_TOKEN in Vercel, redeploy, verify live smokes, then remove ATLAS_B2B_JWT.
- Browser-upload and paid-unlock live smokes remain separate go-live checks after the env is deployed.

Parked hardening:
- None.

Verification:
- npm --prefix web ci
- npm --prefix web run test:deflection-intake-atlas-submit
- npm --prefix web run test:deflection-live-submit-smoke
- bash scripts/local_pr_review.sh
